title: Scene Description 场景描写：只写会影响故事的环境
keywords: Scene Description 场景描写：只写会影响故事的环境
brain_first: 按原文查阅 Scene Description 场景描写：只写会影响故事的环境

blocks.text: 续写中的环境不是为了堆形容词，而是服务动作和情绪。基础学生每次写1-2个有用细节就够。

rows: The rain/wind made it difficult to...
The heavy rain made the road hard to see.

The street was already dark/
quiet...
The street was almost empty by then.
A weak cry came from behind the fence.

The narrow path was blocked by a fallen
branch.
blocks.text:
Need | Safe pattern | Example
Weather affects action | The rain/wind made it difficult to... | The heavy rain made the road hard to see.
Light/time creates
mood | The street was already dark/
quiet... | The street was almost empty by then.
Sound triggers action | A sound/voice came from... | A weak cry came from behind the fence.
Place gives obstacle | The path/door/gate was... | The narrow path was blocked by a fallen
branch.

rows: 规则：如果删掉这句环境描写，人物行动和情绪完全不受影响，那么它可能只是凑字数。
